summary: This page shows how many Right to Information (RTI) applications were filed with government departments in {district}, how many were answered, how many are still waiting and how long replies take, department by department.
emptyTitle: No RTI filing data yet for {district}.
emptyBody: We are collecting RTI filing statistics and department-wise reply data from official RTI sources. You can still file an RTI today.
explain: In {period}, {filed} RTI applications were filed here, and {pending} applications were waiting for a reply. Out of every 10 of these applications, about {n} were still waiting.
picto: About {n} of every 10 RTI applications were still waiting for a reply in {period}.
rateNote: Applications still waiting, as a share of new and waiting applications
ctaBody: Pick a ready-made letter, copy it and file it online.
daysUnits: Average number of days each department took to reply. The line marks the 30-day limit in the RTI Act, 2005.
daysUnitsTop: Average number of days each department took to reply. The line marks the 30-day limit in the RTI Act, 2005. The {n} slowest departments are shown.
daysSimpleOver: {over} of {n} {n, plural, one {department} other {departments}} took longer than the 30-day limit on average.
daysSimpleAll: {n, plural, one {The department replied within the 30-day limit on average.} other {All # departments replied within the 30-day limit on average.}}
daysAria: Average days to reply, by department, slowest first
chartUnits: Number of RTI applications per department. Grey is filed, colour is answered, red is still waiting.
